name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a ⊆ c ++ [h1]) (hb : b ⊆ d ++ [h1]) :
      a ++ b ⊆ (c ++ d) ++ [h1] := by grind
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld]
  case const | bvar | fvar | op =>
    exact fun _ hx => List.mem_append_left _ hx
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case ite ih1 ih2 ih3 => exact join (join ih1 ih2) ih3
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · exact fun _ hx => List.mem_append_right _ hx
      · assumption
    · exact join ih1 ih2

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  change extractOldExprVars post ⊆ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post
  induction h <;>
    simp_all [extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case app fn e m hfn he hf ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · next hfalse =>
      have h := hf IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases h
      exfalso
      apply hfalse
      rfl
    · grind

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := InitStatesLength hi
  have hm := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hm
      (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · simp only [List.unzip_zip, hm, hl]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [hn k hk'] using (UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk)

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  change f x₀ = 0
  by_contra hx₀
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' _ _ hf continuous_const
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    (real_inner_self_nonneg' (x := f x₀)).lt_of_ne'
      ((inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).not.mpr hx₀)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcont) x₀ hpos
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hφ : IsTestFunction (φ : Y → ℝ) := ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have hzero := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (hφ.smul_right contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hzero
  have hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball hx).le
    · rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (le_of_not_gt hx), zero_mul]
  have hprod := (φ.continuous.mul hcont).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    (μ := μ) φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hnonneg
    (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).ne' hpos.ne')
  exact hprod.ne' hzero

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hcurl (j : Fin d) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
        ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
        ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i))]
    simp_rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sub (hEd i j).differentiableAt (hEd j i).differentiableAt]
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hρ : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
      (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
    change fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x (Space.basis i) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y / 𝓕.ε₀) x (Space.basis i) at hg
    simpa only [div_eq_inv_mul,
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
      fderiv_const_mul (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt,
      _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] using hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    change fun s => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s
    enter [s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, hcurl, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hρ, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp <;> ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let t : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓕.WickAlgebra := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF
  change (t ∘ₗ mulLinearMap (a * c)) b =
    (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ mulLinearMap a) b
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun r ↦ ?_) b
  change (t ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip (ofCrAnListFBasis r) ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip c) a =
    (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ
      mulLinearMap.flip (ofCrAnListFBasis r)) a
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun l ↦ ?_) a
  change ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis l * c * ofCrAnListFBasis r) =
    ι (c * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis l * ofCrAnListFBasis r))
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
  let l₁ := List.takeWhile (fun x => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ x)
      ((l ++ r).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel) ++
    List.filter (fun x => crAnTimeOrderRel φ x ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel x φ) l
  let l₂ := List.filter (fun x => crAnTimeOrderRel φ x ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel x φ) r ++
    List.filter (fun x => crAnTimeOrderRel φ x ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel x φ)
      ((l ++ r).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)
  have hs (m : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hm : ∀ x ∈ m, crAnTimeOrderRel φ x ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel x φ) :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (l ++ m ++ r)) = crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ m ++ r) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι (ofCrAnListF m) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂)) := by
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ l m r hm]
    simp only [map_smul, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, l₁, l₂, mul_assoc]
  have h₁ := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h₂ := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h₁ h₂
  have hc : c = ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ] -
      𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ] := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
      superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
    simp
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ φ :: ψ :: r) •
    (ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι c * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂))
  · rw [hc]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc,
      List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [h₁, h₂, crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
    rw [smul_sub, smul_comm (𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ))
      (crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ ψ :: φ :: r))]
  have h₀ : crAnTimeOrderList (l ++ r) = l₁ ++ l₂ := by
    simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, l₁, l₂, List.append_assoc] using
      insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l r
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
    mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← h₀]
  by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
      ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    simp only [c, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case abs => grind
  case tabs => grind
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with w | ⟨_, h⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    have lc := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp lc h⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    have b := (body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v b⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h b⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact .inl (.inl v)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact .inl (.inr v)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v
      · cases v with
        | inl v => exact ⟨_, .case_inl v b₂ b₃⟩
      · cases v with
        | inr v => exact ⟨_, .case_inr v b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case red_I a =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c a' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K a b =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par a' b' ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, hu, .red_K _ _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hu hc) (.par hv hc), .red_S _ _ _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ ha]
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, hu⟩
    case red_S =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb)⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := iha ha''
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩ := ihb hb''
      exact ⟨_, .par hu hv, .par hu' hv'⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice hb =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨q', hq, h'⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL hq, .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨p', hp, h'⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL hp, .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim hb =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨q', hq, h'⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨q', hq, .bisim h'⟩
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨p', hp, h'⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨p', hp, .bisim h'⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_next := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem
    (show ((fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard)
      '' Set.univ).Nonempty from Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  change Y.ncard = d at hg
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
    (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega)
  have hcount : hammingDist f g ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [← hg, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.image₂ F Y.toFinset Finset.univ).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro x hx
        refine Finset.mem_image₂.mpr
          ⟨iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x,
            ?_, pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
              (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        · exact Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩
        · exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
            x _).mp rfl
      _ ≤ _ := by
        simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
          Finset.card_image₂_le F Y.toFinset Finset.univ
  have hfw : 2 * d ≤ d_next - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have halg : (d_next - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [d_next, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
      show ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i by omega,
      show ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - ↑i by omega]
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < d_i := by
    apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (h := by dsimp only [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]; omega)
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * (d * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcount
      _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (d_next - 1) * 2 ^ steps := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hfw
      _ = _ := halg
  unfold hammingClose
  refine (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property)
    (2 : ℕ∞)).trans_lt ?_
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr hnat

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ ℓ := i.isLt
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have h_fiber : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i hi y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i hi y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 hi
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hsplit (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 1).val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 0).val) =
      P_i_plus_1.eval y.val
  rw [hsplit, hsplit]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [h_fiber]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul,
        Fin.eta, Nat.sub_add_eq, mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => rfl)

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) u,
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq
          (fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        zero_add, Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      simpa only [jointProximityNat₂, hu] using
        hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form (ϑ := n + 1) u] at hp
      have hp := lt_of_lt_of_eq hp (prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (MC := MC) u e))
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (n + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le
        (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e hp) ?_
      apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC)
        (ih := ih (Nat.succ_pos _)) (u := u) ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hf : ∀ n, f n ∈ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := fun n =>
    ⟨⟨(hB n).1, (hB (n + 1)).1, (hB (n + 2)).1, (hB (n + 3)).1⟩,
     ⟨(hB n).2, (hB (n + 1)).2, (hB (n + 2)).2, (hB (n + 3)).2⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ :=
    (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem hf
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, f (i + k) = f (j + k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact heq
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
      refine ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, ?_⟩
      apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      erw [(hu (i + k + 4) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + k + 4) (by omega)).1]
      erw [ih.1, ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2]
      rfl
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have he : u (j + (n - i)) = u (i + (n - i)) :=
    congrArg Prod.fst (h (n - i)).symm
  simpa only [show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) by omega,
    show i + (n - i) = n by omega] using he

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hI : (P : Set (Set S)).Intersecting :=
    fun A hA B hB h => hPP A hA B hB h.eq_bot
  have hc := hI.is_max_iff_card_eq.mp (by
    intro Q hQ hPQ
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
    intro T hT
    by_contra h
    exact hPS ⟨T, h, fun U hU he =>
      hQ hT (hPQ hU) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr he)⟩)
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by decide : 0 < 2)
  rw [hc, Fintype.card_set, ← pow_succ',
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Fintype.card_pos (α := S))]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have step (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hab : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ (b i - a i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    convert ((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i using 1
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, ((if j = i then (b j - a j) * 10 ^ j.1 else 0) +
          a j * 10 ^ j.1) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        by_cases hij : j = i <;> simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte] <;> ring
  intro d e f h
  have hd := step d e h.1
  have he := step e f h.2
  have hs : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
    have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
    simpa only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hs
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    convert dvd_sub hs (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;> ring
  intro i
  have hi : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    convert dvd_sub hsum (dvd_add (hd i) (he i)) using 1 <;> ring
  have hp : Prime (7 : ℤ) := Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)
  exact (hp.dvd_mul.mp hi).resolve_right
    (fun h => (by decide : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ 10) (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h))
